entities.summary: Jan Hrušínský is a Czech actor. He has appeared in 56 films and television shows since 1970. He starred in the 1974 film Kdo hledá zlaté dno, which was entered into the 25th Berlin International Film Festival. He is a son of the Czech actor Rudolf Hrušínský.

entities.summary: Jan Hrušínský is a Czech actor. He has appeared in 56 films and television shows since 1970. He starred in the 1974 film Kdo hledá zlaté dno, which was entered into the 25th Berlin International Film Festival. He is a son of the Czech actor Rudolf Hrušínský.
